reviews.title: Easy operation
reviews.comment: Excellent technology. I needed it because of the lack of disc port on my PC. Worked perfectly.
reviews.author: Glenn

reviews.title: Delivered on time and worked right out of the box.
reviews.comment: The BPAKDU external drive performs very well and I really like the other plug ins that it has. Having the SD drive works well with my trail cams that I have. The greatest thing about this is that I didn't have to do anything but plug it in to my PC and worked right out of the box. Totally simple...
reviews.author: Matt

reviews.title: Good, but CD Latch needs work.
reviews.comment: Works well. The latching mechanism could be better but for the price it is fine. It is quite noisy when ripping CDs in comparison to ones I've had in the past but it is easy enough to use. The additional features make it handy.
reviews.author: Joe Reigens

reviews.title: Adds functionality to a newer laptop
reviews.comment: This drive works out of the box.  My new laptop lacked a DVD drive for looking at an older DVD information file.  This drive is plug and play, read the files and did not require a driver.
reviews.author: Whidbey Island

reviews.title: For those that have need to read a CD or DVD, your search is over.
reviews.comment: Disk drive arrived with a short non attached USB A to C cable. Permanently attached is a USB 3A / C cable. This connects to the  computing device (PC, Mac, laptop). The transfer / power cable is extremely short. Worked OK for the laptop, but would not work in my PC use. My PC (Minis Forum) is mounted behind my monitor making termination very difficult. I purchased a AINOPE USB C Extension Cable 6.6FT, 20Gbps/240W USB3.2 Type C Extender Cord to resolve this issue. Works like a charm. I have a clear desk, with the DVD drive now sitting on the monitor shelve where I can connect to my PC or my laptop without problem. I had 10 old DVD's of images that were being stored as backup media, but had no way to retrieve the data till now. I was able to transfer the images to another media, thanks to the drive and the cable. Reading a DVD with 2.6 GB of data, I was able to complete the transfer of 35753 files to my laptop with a Crucial BX500 2TB 3D NAND SATA 2.5-Inch Internal SSD in 61 minutes. The additional ports for the USB hub show up in explorer but I have not tested the capabilities of the hub. All in all I am well pleased with the results from the DVD drive, extension cable and the  SSD.
reviews.author: Thomas Bogan
